_note: Stock MicroPython v1.29.0 (ESP32_GENERIC, micropython.org, fetched by tools/fetch-micropython.sh) booted by the ROM from the combined image at 0x1000, with the demo's LittleFS filesystem (examples/ttgo-tdisplay, built by its build-vfs.sh) in the vfs partition at 0x200000: main.py imports app, a pure-Python spot-price screen on st7789py. Its config.json has no ssid, so the app skips Wi-Fi and draws demo_prices.json at once — the browser has no sockets. The console prints PRICES demo and DRAWN demo; the panel is drawn landscape (MADCTL 0x68), shown rotated 270 degrees.
